data.job_description: Google is seeking an experienced Senior Python Backend Engineer to join our Core Services team. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy high-throughput microservices using Python, FastAPI, and Flask. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate PostgreSQL, Redis caching, and Docker containers into Kubernetes clusters on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Key responsibilities include designing RESTful APIs, optimizing database queries, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring 99.99% service availability. Qualifications: 4+ years of backend development with Python, hands-on expertise in PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Linux, and REST API design. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and message queues (Kafka, Celery) is highly desirable.

Qualifications: 4+ years of Python software development (FastAPI, Flask)
Proficiency in PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and Git
Experience with REST APIs, Linux, and CI/CD pipelines

data.job_description: Microsoft Azure Developer Division is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer. Qualifications: Proficient in React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js
Solid backend skills with Python or REST APIs
Hands-on experience with SQL, Docker, Git, and HTML5/CSS3

data.job_description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Cloud DevOps Engineer to scale cloud infrastructure across global regions. You will write infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, configure AWS services (EC2, S3, IAM, EKS, Lambda), and automate continuous delivery using Jenkins, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions. You will orchestrate containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes, monitor production systems with Prometheus/Grafana, and write automation scripts in Python and Bash. Qualifications: Experience with AWS or Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, Git, Linux system administration, and Python/Bash scripting.

Qualifications: Hands-on experience with AWS, EC2, S3, and IAM
Deep familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform
Strong CI/CD, Linux, Bash, Git, and Python automation skills

Qualifications: Proficiency in SQL, Python, Pandas, NumPy, statistical modeling, machine learning, data visualization (Power BI, Tableau), and Git.

Qualifications: Advanced SQL query optimization and relational database knowledge
Python data science stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn
Data visualization, A/B testing, and business analytics

data.job_description: Cloudflare is hiring a Cyber Security & Cloud Infrastructure Analyst.
